name: list-kanban-grouped
title: Grouped Task List with Handles
description: A kanban flattened into collapsible status groups: drag a task by its grip within or across groups while the others make room, with work-in-progress limits that turn red when exceeded. Keyboard users lift with Space, move with the arrows and drop or cancel, with every move announced.
author: Hyperblur <hello@hyperblur.dev>
